title: 2020 general election results by precinct for St. Joseph County (OpenElections Indiana)
notes: MIT licence. Races read: President, Governor, Attorney General, U.S. House 2nd District (every precinct), State Senate and State Representative districts. County sums equal the official canvass for every race: Governor and Attorney General (results.csv), President and U.S. House (county summary report 42820), legislative districts (results.csv). Two U.S. House figures (Olive Twp 1, Greene Twp 2) and one mislabelled office row (South Bend 130111, House 8 filed as Senate 8) are corrected from the county's 2020 precinct report (MAP-009). Local copy sources/precincts/openelections-in/. Precinct names ('Centre Twp 1') converted to 6-digit county precinct codes by the build script.

title: 2024 general election results by precinct for St. Joseph County (OpenElections Indiana)
notes: MIT licence. Races read: President, U.S. Senate, Governor, Attorney General, U.S. House 2nd District, State Senate and State Representative districts, and the county offices on the 2024 ballot (commissioners, council districts, recorder, treasurer, coroner, surveyor, probate judge). County or district sums equal the official totals for every race except Probate Judge, whose results.csv row is from a scan (sum shown as not checked). President, U.S. Senate and U.S. House checked against the county's FINAL official results (64951). Local copy sources/precincts/openelections-in/.

title: 2022 General Election Signed Official Report with precincts (Precinct Detail Report)
notes: 610-page scanned PDF with an OCR text layer; the build script reads every partisan federal, state, legislative and county race per precinct and checks each race's candidate sum against the printed Total Votes and the county or district sums against the report's summary pages or results.csv. Local copy sources/precincts/sjc-county/.

title: TIGERweb Census 2020 WMS layer 58: Voting Districts

title: 2020 General Election Precinct Summary Report (12/9/2020) for St. Joseph County
publisher: St. Joseph County Election Board (archived by OpenElections)
notes: 590-page scanned county report; copy in sources/precincts/openelections-sources-in/ with OCR text at three resolutions. Source of the map's 2020 county races (each precinct race box accepted only if votes add to the printed total, printed percentages match, and the OCR passes agree) and of three corrections to the OpenElections 2020 file.

title: IC 3-11-2-12: order of offices on the general-election ballot (all groups)
notes: Read for the map's race order beyond the federal and state offices in IND-064: federal and state offices (President, U.S. Senator, Governor, Secretary of State, state comptroller/auditor, Treasurer, Attorney General, U.S. Representative; a same-day vacancy election right after the regular race); legislative (State Senator, State Representative); circuit and county judicial (circuit court judge, superior court judge, probate court judge, prosecuting attorney, circuit court clerk); county (auditor, recorder, treasurer, sheriff, coroner, surveyor, assessor, commissioner, council member); then township, city and town offices. FindLaw notes its text may lag the current code.

title: County Commissioner Boundaries (County_Commissioner_2022), St. Joseph County GIS Hub
notes: 3 polygons, field Dist = 1-3. Item created 2022-10-17, data last edited 2025-02. Read as GeoJSON (outSR 4326). Raw sources/boundaries/districts/raw/county-commissioner-2022/; derived county-commissioner-2022.geojson. Checked against the 2024 results: all 73 District 2 precincts and 70 of 71 District 3 precincts have their centroid in the matching polygon (the 71st, 090204, is not in the 2025 precinct layer).

title: County Council 2025 (County_Council_2025), St. Joseph County GIS Hub

Raw sources/boundaries/districts/raw/county-council-2022/; derived county-council-2022.geojson.

title: Ordinance 10906-22 (Bill 72-22) amending South Bend Municipal Code Ch. 1 Sec. 1-4, Six Councilmanic Districts
publisher: South Bend Common Council / City Clerk
notes: Passed 2022-11-28, presented to the Mayor 2022-11-29 (mayor signature date partly illegible). Lists the precincts in each of the six districts; Exhibit A legal descriptions and Exhibit B map are on file with the City Clerk and were not in the text view. Redistricting under IC 36-4-6-3; city population 103,453 (2020 Census). First used in the 2023 municipal election.
